attributes.board_name: Rhode Island Board of Physical Therapy (Rhode Island Department of Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Scope-of-practice-specific offerings (presentations, conferences, accredited college coursework, online/self-study; 1 CE hour per hour) sponsored or approved by Board-approved organizations, incl. ACCME, AMA, APTA and state PT associations, FSBPT, AOTA, ASHA, ANA, NATA, NSCA, AHA and Red Cross CPR/first aid, PT schools, and courses approved by other state PT licensing boards. Teaching/clinical supervision of students in APTA-approved programs max 3 hours per cycle.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Physical therapists initially licensed by examination after the May 1 renewal date are exempt until the next renewal cycle (April 30 of the next even-numbered year).
rules.audit_note: Licensee attests to completion on the renewal application; keep documentation (course descriptions, proof of attendance) at least 4 years; subject to random audit by the Department of Health.
rules.notes: Biennial renewal; licenses expire May 1 of the even year following issuance (the rule elsewhere sets the late-fee cutoff at March 31 of the even year). No mandatory topics in the rule.
rules.rule_quote: On application for renewal of license, physical therapists shall attest to completion of twenty-four (24) hours biennially in scope of practice-specific offerings…
